question: Will SpaceX launch Starlink 17-53 by 23:59 UTC on August 5, 2026?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the SpaceX Falcon 9 Starlink 17-53 mission lifts off from Vandenberg SFB at any time before 23:59 UTC on August 5, 2026, regardless of mission outcome after liftoff. Resolves NO if the launch has not occurred by that time (scrubs/delays past the deadline resolve NO).
